coverage.reason: The PR adds no server, route, or RPC: the plugin is client-only and registers only timeline transformers and composer pills; authorization stays in the host daemon.
No object is loaded by an ID from a request; the plugin only reads the timeline of agents the host already lists to the same user.

Command text, file content and tool output from agents are rendered by highlight.ts and step-bodies.tsx; checked that they become React Native <Text> children, with no innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML or eval.
No redirect, navigation or location write exists in the changed code (grep for redirect/location/navigate found none).
No upload or file-write path; the plugin never writes files.
Checked agent-activity/** and the CI/dependabot files for process.env, tokens and keys: none; the only storage is localStorage for the detail level (web.ts).
The plugin renders tool output the host already shows; it adds no endpoint and sends nothing over the network, checked by grep for fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket in client/ and shared/.
The change sets no cookie or session; the only browser storage is localStorage for a three-value UI preference.

conditions.base: Paseo web UI with agent-activity disabled (paseo plugin disable); main has no such plugin
conditions.head: same daemon with agent-activity enabled from PR head 51519a2

limits: Not a penetration test, dependency CVE audit, or load test.
project-runtime.md declares no probe budget and no role accounts; the limit 20 is the skill default and no probe ran (the plugin has no server/HTTP surface).
Base is the same Paseo build with the plugin disabled, not a git base: main has no agent-activity plugin.

LCP/CLS/TBT/long tasks were measured on the Paseo app load plus opening the fixture agent (5 interleaved runs per side, A/A with 5 more base runs); CLS 0.222 and TBT ~520ms exceed the abs budgets on BOTH sides, so they belong to the host app (PRE_EXISTING, level warn).

Exact HARs (50 MB each, JS bundle embedded) were kept outside the repo in /tmp/spc: 5 entries per page load on both sides, background requests after navigation 1 on both; scan-bodies found 0 hits. The plugin talks over the existing WebSocket, which Playwright HARs do not capture per message.
